name: singlet_abundance_phenotype_associated_cells
title: Phenotype-associated cell neighbourhoods
description: Tests whether each cell's neighbourhood abundance across samples covaries with a sample-level phenotype after adjusting for covariates and batch or donor strata. Returns a global p-value (cna only), per-cell statistics and FDR-controlled cell calls. Use method cna by default, milo for count-based neighbourhood tests, and meld only for an ordered dose or time series. Requires a kNN graph, a cell-to-sample column and a per-sample phenotype. Do not use it for cell-type proportion changes or for expression differences.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

sample_key.description: obs column giving the sample identifier of each cell.

phenotype_key.description: Sample-level phenotype column, numeric, binary or ordered; constant within donor when strata_keys[1] is set.

covariate_keys.description: Sample-level covariates adjusted for by cna and milo; ignored by meld.

strata_keys.description: Up to two columns, batch then donor. Batch enters residualisation and permutation; donor is the permutation unit.

method.description: cna is the default; milo for count-based neighbourhood tests; meld only for ordered phenotypes.

fdr_levels.description: Nominal FDR levels at which cells are called.

options.description: Shared and method-specific settings; each block applies only to its named method, graph applies to all.

graph.description: Embedding and graph keys shared by all methods.

use_rep.description: obsm embedding the kNN graph was built on; milo uses it for neighbourhood refinement.

graph_key.description: obsp key of the kNN connectivities matrix.

cna.description: Options for the covarying neighbourhood analysis.

n_permutations.description: Conditional permutations for the global p-value and the FDR null.

n_steps.description: Diffusion steps; null stops adaptively by median kurtosis, capped at 15.

self_weight.description: Self-weight w in the diffusion update.

ridge.description: Batch ridge penalty; null selects it from the default list by batch kurtosis.

allow_low_sample_size.description: Permit fewer than 10 samples; power and permutation resolution are then poor.

prop.description: Fraction of cells sampled as neighbourhood index cells.

d_pcs.description: Embedding dimensions used for refined index-cell placement.

refined.description: Use refined index-cell placement as miloR does.

norm_method.description: Library-size normalisation for the negative-binomial model.

fdr_weighting.description: Weights for the graph-spatial FDR; k-distance uses the k-th neighbour distance.

meld.description: Options for the MELD heat-kernel likelihood.

beta.description: Heat-kernel bandwidth of the graph filter.

filter_type.description: Graph filter; heat is the reference default.

sample_normalize.description: Column-normalise sample indicators to sum to one before filtering.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for conditional permutations and their FDR null.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing phenotype_assoc_* members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written; empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs; never per-cell arrays.

n_units.description: Cells tested (cna, meld) or index neighbourhoods (milo).

global_p.description: Global permutation p-value; null unless method is cna.

selected_components.description: Component count at the minimum p (cna).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
